name: Gemma 4 31B
short: Google's 30.7B dense open-weight (Apache 2.0, 256K) model for local reasoning and coding; AIME 89.2% and Codeforces 2150 Elo, MMMU-Pro 76.9%.
pricingNote: Free open weights (Apache 2.0); Free on NVIDIA NIM / Build
freeTierNote: Free prototyping endpoint on NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com); Apache 2.0 open weights for self-hosting
standout: Google’s laptop-class open weights: dense 31B with olympiad-math strength and competitive Codeforces play on a single accelerator.
tradeoff: No hosted frontier sibling for the heavy stuff — the 256K window and 31B depth cap the hardest agentic runs.
